tool_args.rationale: The large target horizon and short-window-positive pilot leave genuine ambiguity about whether the response reverses at long horizons. Acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Short-window rows only establish positive gain; long-horizon reversal remains untested at H≈23.9.
No current evidence points to a coupled memory ODE; this is more expensive and unnecessary for the indicated dual-horizon mechanism.
Irrelevant to the horizon-dependent reversal question and explicitly not worth acquiring.
